policy: Do not activate doses until population, indication, safety, source and QA are reviewed. RDA/UL are not supplement prescriptions.
supported_context: help meet total protein requirements if dietary intake is insufficient

protocols.amount: estimated evidence-based total protein target minus estimated dietary protein

personalization: Weight and training can inform total daily protein target, but powder dose depends on verified dietary gap; not automatic grams of whey per kg.
next_review: Source and validate age/activity-specific total protein ranges and feasible dietary assessment.
